data.title: Curious by Nature | Newswise – Benefits of Single-Port Robotic Mitral Valve Repair | Newswise
data.description: Up to 5% of the population lives with a leaking heart valve condition known as mitral valve prolapse, often without even realizing it. If left untreated, it can lead to heart failure, irregular heartbeats, or sudden cardiac events. While past treatments required major open-chest surgery, a breakthrough in medical robotics is offering a faster, less painful path to recovery.
